Egypt Trip Cost Estimator

How we calculate this

Estimate = (nights × base rate) + (travelers × per-person guiding/transport) + a hotel-tier night surcharge + optional domestic flights. These are placeholder rates from a starter rate card, modelled on typical shoulder-season pricing for a small private journey — swap in Egyphoria's real contracted pricing before treating this as a quote.

Data source: Egyphoria placeholder rate card (as of 2026-09-01)

Questions

Does this include international flights to Egypt?

No — only the optional domestic Cairo–Luxor–Aswan leg. International flights to and from Egypt are priced and booked separately.

Are these Egyphoria's real prices?

No. These are placeholder rates flagged “as of 2026-09” — treat this as a starting estimate, not a quote. Reach out and we'll put together your real price.
